final_netlist:
.subckt dut vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias
* ---- bias: sink IREF with diode-connected nfet ----
MB   ibias ibias vss  vss nfet W=4 L=1
* ---- tail current source ----
MT   tail  ibias vss  vss nfet W=8 L=1
* ---- NMOS input pair ----
M1   d1    vinn  tail vss nfet W=10 L=0.5
M2   x     vinp  tail vss nfet W=10 L=0.5
* ---- PMOS mirror load (diode on M1 side) ----
M3   d1    d1    vdd  vdd pfet W=6 L=1
M4   x     d1    vdd  vdd pfet W=6 L=1
* ---- second stage: PMOS common source + NMOS sink ----
M7   vout  x     vdd  vdd pfet W=60 L=1
M8   vout  ibias vss  vss nfet W=40 L=1
* ---- Miller compensation with nulling resistor ----
Rz   x     cz    2000
Cc   cz    vout  1e-12
.ends dut
